name: Lever Seated Calf Raise
how_to:
1. Setup: Sit on the machine with your knees bent at 90 degrees, feet placed shoulder-width on the foot platform. The thigh pad should rest securely on top of your thighs, just above the knees.
2. Adjust Load: Load the desired weight onto the lever arms. Start conservatively and focus on full range of motion.
3. Start Position: Release the safety mechanism. Let your heels lower slowly to feel a deep stretch in the calves.
4. Raise: Press through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, focusing on strong contraction in the soleus.
5. Pause and Contract: Hold at the top for 1–2 seconds, fully contracting the calves without bouncing.
6. Lower Under Control: Let your heels return to the starting position under slow, deliberate control for a full eccentric stretch.
7. Repeat: Perform the desired number of reps while maintaining strict form.
